provenance.tools: bash (cat, grep, sha256sum); python3 -I with standard library (re, json, hashlib) for regex search of <ref, cite templates, '10.', pmid/doi/pubmed and for verifying text[cp:cp+len(quote)]==quote; lxml.html to list <sup typeof=mw:Extension/ref> ids/data-mw and <li id=cite_note-...> text. All labels decided by reading the text. Process deviation: early on I saved one helper listing script (html.py) under the scratchpad folder 'evaltools/' outside the annotation directory; it vanished from disk shortly after and I then ran all snippets inline via stdin. No repository file was written or read beyond the guide.
